facts.text: The resort is located just outside downtown Austin, on 4,000 wooded acres in the Texas Hill Country.
facts.excerpt: Omni Barton Creek Resort & Spa is located just outside of downtown Austin, situated on 4,000 wooded acres in the beautiful Texas Hill Country.

facts.text: The resort has four championship golf courses.
facts.excerpt: the resort features thoughtfully appointed guest rooms and suites, four championship golf courses, and the world-class Mokara Spa

facts.text: The resort offers 72 holes of golf.
facts.excerpt: 72 holes of top-ranked golf

facts.text: The resort has three pools, including an adults-only pool.
facts.excerpt: Three pools, including an adults-only pool

facts.text: Mokara Spa guests have access to spa amenities including a private pool deck, sauna and cold plunge.
facts.excerpt: enjoy access to exclusive spa amenities including a private pool deck, sauna, cold plunge and more

facts.text: Mokara Spa is inspired by the area's creeks and springs.
facts.excerpt: the Mokara Spa—a 13,000-foot temple to wellness inspired by the area’s creeks and springs

facts.text: Suites come in one- or two-bedroom layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Our spacious suites are available in one or two bedroom layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows boasting breathtaking views

facts.text: Deluxe rooms have eclectic decor reminiscent of Hill Country style.
facts.excerpt: Deluxe rooms with eclectic décor reminiscent of Hill Country style

facts.text: Guest rooms are decorated with warm touches of Southern decor and open up to the evergreen hills around the property.
facts.excerpt: Bright guest rooms are decorated with warm touches of Southern decor and open up to the evergreen hills surrounding the property

facts.text: The outdoor pools are immersed in views of the Texas Hills.
facts.excerpt: the outdoor pools which are fully immersed in stunning views of the Texas Hills

facts.text: There are nine dining outlets: six full-service restaurants, a lobby bar, a coffee shop and a pool bar.
facts.excerpt: Nine dining outlets - six full-service restaurants, a lobby bar, a coffee shop and a pool bar

facts.text: Dining ranges from fresh seafood and classic steakhouse fare to sunset cocktails with Hill Country views.
facts.excerpt: From fresh seafood and classic steakhouse fare to sunset cocktails with Hill Country views, discover our nine dining destinations across the resort.

facts.text: The resort has a self-guided nature trail.
facts.excerpt: Self-guided nature trail

facts.text: The resort has full-sized tennis courts and a fitness center with Peloton bikes.
facts.excerpt: A fully-equipped fitness center with Peloton bikes

facts.text: The resort offers family-friendly activities and seasonal events.
facts.excerpt: Family-friendly resort activities

facts.text: Austin-Bergstrom International Airport is about 18 miles, or about 30 minutes, away.
facts.excerpt: About 18 miles (30 minutes) from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS).

facts.text: The resort is pet friendly for animals under 60 pounds, with a one-time non-refundable pet fee.
facts.excerpt: Omni Barton Creek Resort & Spa is a pet friendly hotel for animals under 60 pounds. There is a one-time non-refundable pet fee of $150 per reservation.

facts.text: Overnight valet parking carries a nightly charge.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking with a nightly charge

facts.text: Guests can head into Austin, the Live Music Capital of the World, for nightlife.
facts.excerpt: Cityside, guests can head to the thumping heart of Austin nightlife where the Live Music Capital of the World always has a new favorite act
